title: Registration diagnostics report fenceBudgetMs as a literal "5000" instead of the enforced budget constant
outcome: Registration diagnostics report fenceBudgetMs as a literal "5000" instead of the enforced budget constant
acceptance: The test-run registration diagnostics derive fenceBudgetMs from TEST_RUN_REGISTRATION_DURABILITY_BUDGET (src/test_run_registration.rs), so the reported budget always equals the enforced one; the POST text stays byte-identical for the current 5 s budget and non-POST methods keep not_applicable.
A regression pins the reported fenceBudgetMs to the constant, and the review pair finds no Medium or higher.
